description:
Simulate selling a Robinhood Chain token and see whether it can be sold at all. Zorvu gives a throwaway address the tokens in a counterfactual read of the chain and tries the sell through the token's deepest pool. Nothing is signed, nothing is sent, no transaction is built and no keys are involved.

Use it before accepting a token as collateral, before sizing an exit, or to catch a token that can be bought but not sold. It covers any token address, not only official Stock Tokens.

`sellable` is `true`, `false` or `"unknown"`, and the three mean different things. `false` is a finding: the sell was refused by the token's own code on a rig that was proven to work on that same token moments earlier. `"unknown"` means Zorvu could not establish either answer, and `reason` says why -- it is never to be read as a pass or as a failure. `true` means one simulated sell of that size returned tokens at the time shown; it does not mean the token is safe, and it is not a promise about a real sale, which happens at a different block against a different pool state.

`impact_pct` compares the fill with a dust-sized sell through the same route: `-4.2` means the simulated size filled 4.2% worse than dust did. `reference_price` and the amounts are ratios of raw token units, and `implied_sell_tax_bps` is not measured in this version -- a tax cannot be told apart from the pool's own fee without the pool's mid price, so it is reported as unknown rather than estimated. Every answer carries `read_at`. Requires a Zorvu API key in the Authorization header of your MCP client config; the tool takes no key argument. Not financial advice.

inputSchema.description: Give the token address. usd defaults to 1000.

address.description: Contract address of the token to try selling. Any Robinhood Chain token, not only an official Stock Token.

usd.description: Size to simulate selling, in US dollars. Applied only when the deepest pool is quoted in a dollar stablecoin; otherwise a fraction of the pool is used and size_usd_applied is false.

name: simulate_sell
title: Simulate selling a token
